subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about the size of atoms?

options.text: All atoms have the same size.
Atoms are visible under an ordinary microscope.
The size of atoms is in the range of nanometres.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The size of atoms is in the range of nanometres**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Atoms** are the fundamental building blocks of matter and are incredibly small in size. The radius of an atom is typically measured in **nanometres (nm)**, where **1 nanometre** is equal to **1/10⁹ metres** (or **10⁻⁹ m**). ***Hence, statement 4 is correct.***
 
• **Molecules** are chemical structures consisting of at least two **atoms** held together by chemical bonds. Because a molecule is a collection of atoms, it is always larger than the individual atoms that compose it. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
